Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

The review ran locally in an isolated worktree. The PR was trial-merged with upstream main `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95` without conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

What looks good:

- The off defaults preserve the existing parameter digests and project files.
- The Trochoidal refusal names the unsupported option.
- The motion pinning suite passed all 5 tests. The app pinning suite passed all 7 tests.
- Both repeated mutations failed at the intended assertion and passed after restoration.

Requested before merge:

1. **Bound relief exemptions by their upper Z limit.** `crates/sim/src/verify/corner_relief.rs:103`, `:126`, and `:146` check the lower limit but omit `z_top`. The full `verify` API suppresses both collisions in the table below. Check the upper height of each swept band and contact. Add tests for cutting edges and shanks above the zone.
2. **Restore a green full UI library suite.** `crates/ui/src/model_link_tests.rs:156` failed in both full runs. Each run had 1,274 passed, 1 failed, and 7 ignored. The test passed alone. Resolve the failure or its isolation cause, then run the full suite again. This file is unchanged in the PR. The cause is not established by this review.
3. **Add the UI evidence and assertions.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs:172` adds the controls, but the PR body has no before/after screenshots. Link images from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not put them on the PR branch. Add structural assertions for the new relief mode and direction controls. The current UI test changes only supply the new field.
4. **Run the reached heavy lanes.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:225` changes cutting motion. The heavy plan selects both `motion heavy` and `app heavy`. The PR body says these were not run. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record the lane results in the body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review,” requires these results before readiness.
5. **Split the new test file.** `crates/app/tests/corner_relief.rs:1` adds a 618-line source file. The current law limits a source file to about 400 lines. Move the shared fixtures to a support module. Split the serialization tests from the cutting and safety tests.

Safety regression evidence:

The fixtures call the full `verify` API in `Mode::Area`. The region and stock are the square `[-40, 40]^2`. The stock top is Z 40 and clearance is Z 45. The tolerance is 0.01 mm.

The cutter radius is 3 mm. Its flute length is 5 mm. Its shank radius and length are 3 and 10 mm. Its holder radius and length are 6 and 10 mm.

The declared relief has corner `(10, 10)`, start `(7, 7)`, end `(7.8786796564, 7.8786796564)`, radius 3, and Z limits 10–20. Each feed follows that XY segment.

| Case | Tip Z | Model cube, min to max | Without the relief zone | With the relief zone |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Shank above the allowed volume | 10 | `(9.5, 7, 22)` to `(10.5, 9, 24)` | `ShankHit { at: 0, part: true }` | `[]` |
| Feed above the allowed volume | 30 | `(9.5, 7, 31)` to `(10.5, 9, 34)` | `Gouge { at: 0 }` | `[]` |

Both collision-retention assertions failed. A third control test passed: the separate stock law retained `RapidInStock` for a rapid through uncut material.

Build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Planned local builds, including app and UI | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 778 of 779 steps passed; UI library failed |
| Full UI library retry, from `crates/ui`, 6 test threads | 1,274 passed; 1 failed; 7 ignored |
| Failed model-link test, run alone | 1 passed |
| Motion `corner_relief` | 5 passed |
| App `corner_relief` | 7 passed |
| Extra fixture suites | 117 binaries; 1,100 passed; 0 failed; 12 ignored |
| Full verifier regression fixtures | 1 passed; 2 failed, as described above |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Heavy motion/app lanes | Not run; required before readiness |
| Release and pixel snapshot lanes | Not run |

The repeated full UI failure was:

```text
model_link_tests::a_changed_file_is_imported_again_as_one_undo_step_and_its_operations_only_go_stale
crates/ui/src/model_link_tests.rs:156:5
assertion `left == right` failed: a new change is imported again: updated part (10 faces, 16 edge chains changed)
  left: 1
 right: 2
```

Mutations repeated locally:

- Omit `&plan.reliefs` in `machining2d/pocket.rs`: `pocket_waterline_square_dogbone_matches_golden` failed with 18 moves instead of 26. It passed after restoration.
- Disable the `WALL_CLEAR_TOL` crossing check in `machining2d/corner_relief.rs`: `unreachable_corner_in_narrow_keyway_is_refused_by_name` failed because generation returned a toolpath. It passed after restoration.

Golden inspection:

I checked all 28 lines of the new golden. It contains 26 moves. The four symmetric spurs leave the `±7` mm anchors, reach `±7.879` mm, and return at floor Z 10. The approach, feed values, closed walks, and final retract match the fixture. No existing golden changed.

Extra suites run:

The changed fixture directory is `crates/app/tests/golden/`. The suites below ran explicitly, in addition to the quick gate. Shared reader modules run inside their parent binaries. No importer or STEP fixture changed, so the extra kernel STEP selection does not apply.

Review fixtures and mutation edits were removed. No review evidence was committed to the PR branch.

Existing files already above the line limit also grow, including `generate.rs` and the project parameter files. Their growth is a non-blocking note.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Bounded relief exemptions by their upper Z limit. `cutting_edge_above_relief_top_keeps_gouge` and `shank_above_relief_top_keeps_part_collision` passed. The sim relief suite passed all 6 tests. The four collision regressions failed after reversion and passed after restoration.
2. Gave each model-link fixture write a distinct modification time. `model_link_tests::a_changed_file_is_imported_again_as_one_undo_step_and_its_operations_only_go_stale` reproduced the original same-size rewrite failure. It passed after restoration.
3. Added structural assertions for relief modes, direction choices, Apply, and undo. `relief_modes_and_direction_controls_edit_each_supported_passes_page` and `relief_mode_and_direction_apply_as_one_undoable_command` passed. Removing the editor call failed the pin. The PR body links before/after images from `pr-screenshots`.
4. Ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` for the reached motion and app lanes. GREEN: 220 steps, 0 unexpected failures; 3 existing #1950 checks were RED as expected.
5. Split fixtures, serialization, cutting, and safety tests into files below 400 lines. All 8 tests passed. `corner_relief_test_modules_stay_under_the_line_law` failed at 652 lines and passed after restoration.

Head: `fa0515aab4754d42992caedeff9b4e87f4cefb6d`.
Quick gate: 779 steps, 0 failed.
Full UI library: 1,277 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
Clippy: all four touched crates and all targets passed with `-D warnings`.
Heavy gate: GREEN: 220 steps, 0 unexpected failures; 3 existing #1950 checks were RED as expected.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut.

The review ran locally in an isolated worktree. The PR was trial-merged with upstream main `5fdbed9bd8e7a8bb28e6f162a02ab423842b77e8` without conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

This review is a re-review. It checks the new head against the five requests of the review at `69ff095a`.

Earlier requests:

1. **Upper Z limit of relief exemptions: met.** `crates/sim/src/verify/corner_relief.rs:107` adds `z_max <= rc.z_top` to `move_on_zone`. `tri_in_zone` (`:126`-`:136`) clips the facet contact to the swept atom band and checks the two relief heights. `mid_in_zone` (`:157`-`:161`) checks the band and the sample point against `z_top`. `crates/sim/tests/corner_relief.rs` pins four collision cases above the relief. It also pins one control case, which keeps a valid contact inside the relief, and one rapid-in-stock control. The two cases of the earlier review (shank above the volume, feed above the volume) are now `cutting_edge_above_relief_top_keeps_gouge` and `shank_above_relief_top_keeps_part_collision`. Both pass.
2. **Full UI library: met.** `crates/ui/src/model_link_tests.rs:69`-`:81` gives each fixture write its own modification time. The test also asserts a same-size change. The full UI library passed here: 1,282 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
3. **UI evidence and assertions: met.** The PR body links one before image and two after images. The images are on commit `231d050a` of the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, not on the PR branch. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural/corner_relief.rs` asserts labels, combo roles, enabled state, all T-bone directions for the three operation types, draft isolation, Apply and one undo. It asserts no position, size or colour.
4. **Reached heavy lanes: met.** The PR body records `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on this head: 220 steps, 0 unexpected failures, 3 known #1950 failures. This review also ran 9 reached heavy steps in release (table below). All passed.
5. **Test file split: met.** The app tests are now four files of 216, 250, 118 and 81 lines. All 8 tests remain.

Build and test results (local, on the trial merge):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate plan, `cl`, `post`, `sim` and `motion` steps | All passed (in chunks: the 10-minute command limit stopped the single gate run) |
| Motion suites after `machining2d` in the plan, 28 binaries | 28 passed |
| App suites of the quick plan, 582 binaries | 582 passed, 0 failed |
| UI library, from `crates/ui`, 6 threads | 1,282 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored |
| UI integration suites of the plan, 11 binaries | 11 passed |
| `camcraft-sim --test corner_relief` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test corner_relief` | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Heavy, release: `app heavy: verify` | Passed (284 s) |
| Heavy, release: `motion heavy: machining2d` | Passed (288 s) |
| Heavy, release: `app heavy:` `corner_relief`, `corner_relief_safety`, `mill2d_b`, `pocket_no_adaptive`, `rest_pocket`, `roughing2d`, `stock_engine_agreement` | 7 passed |
| Other heavy steps | Not run here. The author's full heavy run on this head is in the PR body. |
| Release and pixel snapshot lanes | Not run |

Mutations repeated locally (each one restored, then the suite passed again with 6 tests):

| Mutation in `crates/sim/src/verify/corner_relief.rs` | Result |
|---|---|
| Disable `contact_max <= rc.z_top + allow` in `tri_in_zone` | RED: `shank_above_relief_top_keeps_part_collision` failed |
| Disable `band[1] <= rc.z_top + allow` in `mid_in_zone` | RED: `enclosed_shank_crossing_relief_top_keeps_part_collision` failed |
| Disable `z_max <= rc.z_top + tol` in `move_on_zone` | GREEN: no test failed (see note 1) |

Golden inspection:

The golden `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_waterline_square_dogbone.cl` did not change since the earlier review. I read all 28 lines again. The pocket is the square of +/-10 mm, and the cutter radius is 3 mm. The last offset ring is at +/-7 mm. Each of the four spurs goes from +/-7 mm to +/-7.879 mm and back, at floor Z 10. The value 7.879 is 10 - 3/sqrt(2), so the cutter edge touches the corner exactly and does not go past it. The approach, the feeds and the final retract agree with the fixture. No other golden changed.

Extra suites run:

The diff adds a file in `crates/app/tests/golden/`. These suites read golden directories, and each one ran explicitly in addition to the quick gate:

- `camcraft-app` (31 binaries, all passed): `altmill_machines, conformance, continuous_4axis_part, corner_relief, golden_cl, grblhal_post, lathe_post_inch, lathe_post_tormach_g76_ladder, microarc_test_part, plasma_post, plasma_post_refusals, pocket_no_adaptive, post_cycle_feed_spindle, program_comments, program_units, sinker_burn, sodick_wire_dielectric, sodick_wire_passes, sodick_wire_post, solid_law_goldens, tinyg_post, tormach_end_units, tormach_fourth_axis, tormach_machines, tormach_post, wire_4axis, wire_burnout, wire_post, wire_tabs, wire_taper, wire_taper_angle`
- `camcraft-post` (18 binaries, all passed): `arc_planes, bore_cycle, doosan_dnm_post, explain_fanuc_family, explain_remaining, explain_tormach, fanuc_post, heidenhain_block_form, heidenhain_cycles, inverted_post, mazak_spindle_words, post_engine, ream_cycle, ream_lathe, recorded_streams, script_sinker_iso, wcs_flip_dialects, work_offset_index`
- `camcraft-cl` (1 binary, passed): `headless_bin`

The diff does not change importer code or STEP fixtures. The extra kernel STEP selection does not apply.

Law check:

- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` was added outside tests in the new commit.
- The new commit does not change process files, `PROCESS_VERSION`, dependencies, `build.rs`, `.github/` or snapshot PNGs.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2400`. The commit subjects are conventional.
- No review evidence is on the PR branch.

Notes (not blocking):

1. The `z_max` check in `move_on_zone` (`crates/sim/src/verify/corner_relief.rs:107`) has no pinning test. In `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:98`-`:106`, it is the only height check that controls the section exemption. The section check skips its gouge reading only when a model is present. Then the solid check also runs, and mutations 1 and 2 pin that check. Thus the case stays refused. A `Mode::Section` fixture with a move above `z_top` would pin this line directly. A follow-up `P7` is sufficient.
2. `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs` grows from 396 to 413 lines. This is above the 400-line limit. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` was already above the limit and grows from 3,989 to 4,078 lines.

The trial merge commit, the mutation edits and the review worktree were removed. No review evidence was committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
